definition: In this test the supplied concreteness criterion is Capacity F ex response. ConcreteAt therefore requires present existence and a witnessed accessible response difference. The criterion is computed from a response table, not an unconstrained has-power atom. Lack of this outgoing capacity does not classify an entity as abstract. Spatial location and independence/actuality are separate unencoded criteria.
note: An analyst-selected capacity criterion, not claimed equivalent to every causal-powers ontology. The recipient has no outgoing capacity; the model makes no abstractness claim about it. Source objections and unmodeled intrinsic directedness are preserved in docs/necessary-concrete-causal-powers.md.
